My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m really sorry to hear that one of your items didn’t arrive in the condition you expected; I know that’s disappointing after waiting for your plants.

Your full name
Your email address
Your order number (or, if you don’t have it handy, the shipping address on the order)
The name(s) of the damaged item(s)
A few clear photos showing:
The outside of the box (including any damage)
The shipping label
The damaged item itself, pulled out of the box
